text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
MostPopulousCapital(x) ::: x is the most populous national capital city.
HostedEvent(x, y) ::: x hosted event y.
HasHostedBothSummerWinterOlympics(x) ::: x has hosted both Summer and Winter Olympics.
HasHostedSummerWinterParalympics(x) ::: x has hosted both Summer and Winter Paralympics.
UniversitiesRankAmongTop(x) ::: many of x's universities rank among the best.
Country(x) ::: x is a country.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
Olympics(x) ::: x is Olympics.
Paralympics(x) ::: x is Paralympics.
Year(x) ::: x is a year.
Universities(x) ::: x are universities.
RankedAmongBest(x) ::: x are ranked among the best.
Premises:
Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China ::: CapitalOf(Beijing, People'sRepublicOfChina)
Beijing is the world's most populous national capital city ::: MostPopulousCapital(Beijing)
Beijing is located in Northern China ::: LocatedIn(Beijing, NorthernChina)
Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics Games ::: HostedEvent(Beijing, SummerOlympics2008) ∧ HostedEvent(Beijing, SummerParalympics2008)
Beijing has hosted both the Summer and Winter Olympics, along with the Summer and Winter Paralympics ::: HasHostedBothSummerWinterOlympics(Beijing) ∧ HasHostedSummerWinterParalympics(Beijing)
Many of Beijing's 91 universities consistently rank among the best in the Asia-Pacific and the world ::: Universities(x) ∧ RankedAmongBest(x)
Conclusion:
LocatedIn(Beijing, SouthernChina)
